description: Address code review issues: add rate limiting to /api/scan, fix admin scanner link, fix scanner camera race condition.
steps: Add rate limiting to /api/scan using existing rateLimit utility from src/lib/rate-limit.ts, keyed on IP (10 requests per minute)
Fix admin events page link: change 'Abrir Scanner de Puerta' href from /admin/events/${id}/puerta to /scanner so it uses the correct qrCode-based flow
Fix scanner cleanup race condition: add scannerReady state with 500ms delay between scanner sessions to allow camera release before re-initialization
acceptance_criteria: /api/scan returns 429 when rate limit is exceeded
Admin events page 'Abrir Scanner de Puerta' link points to /scanner
Scanner page waits 500ms after clearing before re-initializing camera
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/invitaciones-digitales && npx next build' and confirm exit code 0
findings: Issue #5 (guest entry page accessible without auth) was left as-is per review guidance since UUIDs are unguessable by design. All other issues resolved.
